model: physical dropshipping; supplier fulfills directly to customer; no inventory owned by operator
frozen_hypothesis: At least one compliant supplier/platform/payment route can fulfill a real order for a Morocco-based seller with zero upfront cash, positive contribution margin after fees/returns, and a lawful payout path.
primary_endpoint: A verified supplier and eligible platform/payment route documented in writing, with all-in order economics showing positive contribution margin and zero required upfront cash.
commercial_success_endpoint: At least one unrelated customer order completed and payout received; simulation and supplier discovery do not count as revenue.
candidate_archetypes: simple phone stands and non-electrical accessories
constraints: No paid subscriptions, ads, inventory, paid APIs, or paid hosting before validation.
Do not create a paid storefront or publish a checkout before payment eligibility is verified.
Do not claim a supplier, fee, price, demand, or payout method is verified without a current primary source or written confirmation.
Do not collect customer personal data or send outreach automatically.
Do not treat illustrative assumptions as real market observations.
Keep this commercial case isolated from the generic Simulation Matrix and from BHD, miRNA-21, and Quran/IQCL.
required_gates: all-in product, shipping, platform, payment, refund and return costs verified
payout method and settlement delay verified
positive contribution margin in base and stress scenarios
consumer, tax, and foreign-exchange obligations reviewed

decision_rule.PASS_TO_MANUAL_PILOT: Every required gate is evidence-backed, zero upfront cash is confirmed, and stress-case contribution margin remains positive.
decision_rule.HOLD_RESEARCH: Any supplier, platform, payout, fee, shipping, return or compliance field is unknown.
decision_rule.FAIL_ZERO_BUDGET_MODEL: Any unavoidable upfront payment is required, or contribution margin is non-positive in the stress case.
decision_rule.COMMERCIAL_SUCCESS: Only after a real unrelated customer order is fulfilled and payout is received.
